guard: a membership watch that closes after setup reaches the browser as the same membership-read-failed frame a rejected read produces, rather than leaving the graph silently stale
why: This suite runs `tsx` directly over `src`, with no build step and no compiled second copy, so no `afterRestore` is needed on the mutation below.

mutations.name: the watch's closed callback stops broadcasting the refusal
mutations.expectRed: a closed watch reaches the browser as the membership-read-failed frame, byte for byte
mutations.cell: a closed watch reaches the browser as the membership-read-failed frame, byte for byte
